newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen falling slightly on lack of news.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen falling slightly on lack of news.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange are expected to fall slightly on a lack of good news to prop up the market, brokers said on Tuesday.
However, they said sentiment was generally positive and any falls were likely to be the result of profit-taking.
"There is no bad news either. The market is moving with logic," said Redwanul Islam of Dastagir Mohammad Adil & Co.
He added that scrips in sound financial poasitions, such as Chittagong Cement and Beximco Pharma could rise marginally.
On Monday the DSE benchmark closed 18.2 points or 1.51 percent lower at 1,179.4.
